text: {"lessons":["I waited through steep declines before selling B, E, C and D at large losses; I should review positions regularly and use clear, forward-looking criteria instead of letting loss aversion delay decisions.","After selling C at a loss, I bought it back and added more as its price rose, then sold again at a loss. I should not let regret or recent price moves drive repeated trades; I need a reasoned plan before re-entering or adding.","I should set limits for position size and risk across the whole portfolio, and decide in advance what evidence would make me hold, buy more or sell—rather than focusing only on each stock’s cost basis."]}
